help.title: Help
help.gettingStartedBody: Add a medicine under Settings: give it a name and say how often you take it — once a day, twice a day, every 8 hours, or as needed. You can change the times, set a course length and more under "More options".
help.checklistBody: The home screen is a checklist for today. "Due now" shows what to take, oldest first — tap Take and it's logged. "Later today" shows what's coming; tap a row to take it early. "Done" shows what you logged today. A dose nobody logged in time moves to "Missed", where you can still take it late or mark it as skipped.
help.lateBody: A late dose doesn't throw off your day. Take the 08:00 dose at 10:00 and the next one moves a little: half an hour for every full hour late (here to 21:00), never past bedtime and never over the night. After that the times are back on the clock. If a dose is very late, the next one also waits long enough that the two aren't too close. A dose can be taken until halfway to the next one (for 08:00 and 20:00: until 14:00). A moved row shows the new time with the old one struck through. You can turn this off per medicine under More options → "Adjust the next dose when I'm late".
help.doubleDoseBody: For scheduled medicines the app only checks for a likely double dose: the dose is already logged, or the last one was less than the minimum gap ago (by default half the time between two doses). It tells you when you took it and lets you log anyway or cancel. It never blocks you.
help.asNeededBody: Painkillers and the like have no schedule. You can set a max per day, a max per intake and a minimum time between doses. "Per day" counts the last 20 hours rather than 24, so getting up earlier than yesterday doesn't trigger a warning. The card shows how much you've used and when the next dose is free.
help.remindersBody: Turn reminders on under Settings → Reminders on each phone or computer you use. You get a heads-up before a dose, a reminder at the time, and repeats until it's logged. Tap Taken or Snooze right on the notification. For people and pets you share, each of you chooses whether to be reminded; a dose logged by anyone stops the reminders for everyone. On iPhone, reminders need the app added to the home screen.
help.unsureBody: Open the app: today's list shows it. If you truly don't remember, log with "Not sure I took it" from the ⋯ button. It fills the slot, so you won't be reminded again, and it's shown faded in history.
help.backdateBody: Forgot to log a dose? Tap "Log an earlier dose" at the bottom of Today or History and pick the time; the sheet tells you which scheduled dose it counts as. A dose from yesterday never fills today's dose. The ⋯ button on a row logs that dose with a different amount, time or note. In History, tap a missed dose and choose "I took it" to log it at the right time.
help.installBody: On iPhone: open in Safari → Share → "Add to Home Screen". On Android/Chrome: menu → "Install app". On desktop: the install icon in the address bar.
help.disclaimer: This app is a reminder and logging aid, not medical advice. Always follow your prescription and your doctor's instructions.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Remember your medicine, and never wonder "did I take it?" again.
onboarding.step1Body: A name and how often: once a day, twice a day, every 8 hours, or as needed.
onboarding.step2Body: The home screen shows what's due now and later today. One tap on Take logs it.
onboarding.step3Body: Turn on reminders and you get a heads-up, then a nudge until the dose is logged.
onboarding.disclaimerAccept: I understand this is not medical advice
